cohort: 97 women with SARS-CoV-2 infection diagnosed at the time of birth, delivering singletons after 24 weeks of gestation, and with a clear immunization status
finding: While there were no differences in other outcomes, vaccination was associated with a lower risk of COVID-19 symptoms and shorter hospital stays in SARS-CoV-2-positive pregnant women.
mod_finding: This study investigated outcomes in SARS-CoV-2-positive pregnant women referred for delivery but did not directly compare different modes of delivery.
